set -e
tmp=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
awk '
function trim(s) {
  sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", s)
  sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", s)
  return s
}
FNR==NR {
  line=trim($0)
  if (line == "" || line ~ /^#/) next
  pos=index(line, "=")
  if (pos == 0) next
  old=trim(substr(line, 1, pos-1))
  new=trim(substr(line, pos+1))
  if (old != "" && new != "") map[old]=new
  next
}
{
  line=$0
  pos=index(line, "=")
  if (pos == 0) { print line; next }
  left=substr(line, 1, pos-1)
  right=substr(line, pos)
  match(left, /^[[:space:]]*/)
  prefix=substr(left, 1, RLENGTH)
  rest=substr(left, RLENGTH+1)
  match(rest, /[[:space:]]*$/)
  trail=substr(rest, RSTART)
  key=substr(rest, 1, length(rest)-length(trail))
  if (key in map) {
    print prefix map[key] trail right
    next
  }
  print line
}
' config/renames.conf config/settings.conf > "$tmp"
if ! cmp -s "$tmp" config/settings.conf; then
  cat "$tmp" > config/settings.conf
  git add -- config/settings.conf
  git -c user.name="config maintenance" -c user.email="config-maintenance@example.invalid" commit -m "config: rename stale settings keys" -- config/settings.conf
fi
